newsitem.title: UK: Gas oil and fuel oil wait in Ventspils for loading.
newsitem.headline: Gas oil and fuel oil wait in Ventspils for loading.

text.p: Cargoes of gas oil and fuel oil are sitting in railway siding at the Baltic port of Ventspils waiting to load, a spokesman at the Latvian port said on Tuesday.
He did not say how many cargoes were delayed.
"The installation is full and product is waiting in the sidings," he said.
The backlog has been caused by recent bad weather which halted loading operations and contributed to a lack of Russian gas oil being offered into the European market, traders said.
"We have to wade through some large cargoes which are heading to the Far East before we know where the fresh barrels are," said one.
Russian gas oil premiums were holding around March IPE +$1 cif ARA although material is not readily offered.
